nom: SOME BY MI Galactomyces Glutathione Glow Milky Toner

avis.texte: The toner has a very thin texture and layers well with both retinol and azeliac acid. I have sensitive acne prone skin and it didn't break me out.

Very impressed with this toner and happy to find it at Ulta! It's soothing to put on, hydrating, blurs pores under makeup, and wears well. Reasonable price point. Im 43 with normal-dry skin, clear complexion. This product does the job of several, making a great addition to a scaleable skin routine
